curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can four mathematicians find a way out before the shrinking room leaves them no space to escape?
curatedMovie.description: Trapped together as their room contracts, four mathematicians have to confront a fatal puzzle with no easy way out.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Tense, fast-paced, and intensely claustrophobic. Demands focused attention under severe, heavy pressure.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: A lean Spanish thriller built on relentless claustrophobia, turning pure logic and problem-solving into a desperate race against physical space.
